title: Make personalised greetings automatic and safe
summary: Uses the user-selected name when valid and automatically falls back to the imported roster identity.
changes: Uses a valid name entered in Personalise first, then the imported roster name, then the approved account display name.
Rejects sentence-like or malformed personal-name values so phrases cannot appear in the Night greeting.
Applies the same automatic behaviour to existing staff and future users without hard-coding individual names.
